subject.title: refactor(protocol): pre-publish cheat-window cleanup and vintage tracking

question: Should the released beta and upcoming public `@openclaw/gateway-protocol` surfaces be intentionally broken in this PR, or should the renamed question/session-catalog contracts remain additive or versioned?
rationale: The code can repair the stale fixture mechanically, but whether beta-tagged and prospective npm consumers may lose the old wire shapes is a product and compatibility policy choice.

options.title: Use additive/versioned contracts
options.body: Preserve the existing beta-facing names and shapes while introducing the cleaned contracts through an explicit version or documented migration path.

options.title: Accept the compatibility window
options.body: Approve removal and renaming of the existing beta contracts, with release notes and client upgrade guidance that make the break explicit.

recommendation.title: Use additive/versioned contracts
recommendation.body: Preserve the existing beta-facing names and shapes while introducing the cleaned contracts through an explicit version or documented migration path.

likelyOwner.reason: They are assigned to the PR and authored the protocol-surface and generated-client changes requiring the compatibility decision.
